condition: At least one positive-quantity StockMovement with Direction=Out exists for an active inventory item.
behavior: OwnerDashboardQueryService.LoadStockAsync sums QuantityMilliUnits only, ignoring Direction. InventoryQueryService.GetInventoryOverviewAsync signs In as +quantity and all other directions as -quantity; InventoryRules.StockBalanceMilliUnits uses the same direction-aware contract. RecordWasteHandler, InventoryDeductionService (order usage and packaging), and outbound count adjustment persist positive QuantityMilliUnits with Direction=Out. Receipt writers use positive quantities with Direction=In. This confirms sign is carried by Direction, not signed quantity.
effect: For In 5,000 and Out 4,000, dashboard projection is 9,000 while canonical inventory balance is 1,000. At minimum 2,000, dashboard excludes the item from low-stock results and understates the low-stock count. Inventory overview agrees with the 1,000 balance.
recommendation: Reuse the direction-aware calculation or shared query helper for owner-dashboard stock, and cover dashboard/overview parity for In+Out, Out-only, and count-adjustment Out cases.
counterevidence: Inventory overview is direction-aware and is the appropriate comparison baseline; this is isolated to owner-dashboard duplicate aggregation.

Lines 536-555 (source review) verify a 10,000 In receipt minus a positive-quantity 2,000 Out count adjustment yields 8,000 in overview. These tests support direction semantics but do not exercise dashboard stock.
